_comment: PLACEHOLDER recipe. Always makeable: 3 wild_thyme in the pot -> a draught, no gate. Making it the first time without already knowing it RECORDS it (learnRecipe -- toast + reward + a recipe book later). Certain events also hand it over early (the rock's moss deed teaches it via grant_recipe -- see observations.json), but that's a shortcut to the record, never a requirement. Output: a consumable whose quality scales on the doing-layer stat + a roll. Making it feeds that stat XP (inverse to mastery). Tune/replace when real content lands.
